title: Vikram and Betal: The Patient Student
moral: Patience is the key to learning.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a student.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a student who wanted to learn quickly.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The student rushed learning and made mistakes.
scenes.image_prompt: student looking frustrated while studying cartoon

scenes.text: Another student studied slowly and understood well.
The student decided to learn with patience.
The student became successful. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.

story: A student learned that patience is important for success. By changing his approach, he succeeded. Vikram said patience leads to learning.
